summary: “Live” indicator: pulsing red dot, localized “Live” label and an optional Intl-formatted viewer count.
whenToUse: Signaling a live stream, an ongoing event or a live session.
Event cards, heroes, video player headers.
whenNotToUse: A person's online status: use Avatar with a presence Badge.
Notifications or counts not related to a live stream: use Badge.

props.name: viewers
props.description: Connected viewers, shown after the label (messages.liveViewers).

props.name: pulse
props.description: Animates the dot (always disabled with prefers-reduced-motion).

inherits: HTML attributes of <span> (id, style, data-*, aria-*).
accessibility: Visible text, no role: the information does not rely on the color of the dot alone, which is decorative (aria-hidden).
It is not a live region: if the viewer count changes often, avoid announcing it on every update.
With prefers-reduced-motion the dot does not pulse; in forced-colors it uses Mark with an outline.
responsive: Compact inline element: wraps with the surrounding text.
customization: Tokens: --dc-color-feedback-danger for the dot; the text inherits the color (works on light and dark backgrounds).
commonMistakes: Leaving it visible after the event has ended: remove it or replace it with a “Replay” Badge.
Formatting the viewer count by hand and ignoring the locale.

examples.name: WithViewers
examples.title: With viewers
examples.description: Formatted number, including compact, on a dark background.

limits: The dot color is fixed (feedback danger) for consistency with the “on air” convention.
